title: SoleasPay V3 API Documentation Update on Monday, 16 Dec 2024
footer:
🌭 SoleasPay powered by Mysoleas.
To get more help about our API don't hesistate to contact us here
context: SoleasPay is a payment gateway allowing to collect and emit payments on web and mobile applications of their customers through their mobile money wallet, bank and even crypto accounts.

base.info: SoleasPay Endpoints support GET, POST, PUT or DELETE Requests.

auth:
SoleasPay API require authenticated token in all header's request.
Depending on the endpoint prefixe, they accept :
  • Bearer Token : For all endpoints started by /api/action
  • x-api-key : For all endpoints started by /api/agent
limits: The number of request is limited to 500 requests per hour, per IP address. If you need a higher limit, please contact us. All IPs sending excessive requests will be down.

callback.info:
In asynchronous system, all requests will be processed and final state will be share to your application through your callback endpoint.

For security reason, all our request must contain a x-private-key header. its value is the hash 512 of your secret hash received after configuring your callback endpoint

contact.info: If you need help using this API, please don't hesistate to contact us by links provided.

endpoints.name: Get Bearer Token
endpoints.text:
The life cycle of the generate token is 60 minutes
Parameters (JSON) :
* public_apikey(string) : Your x-api-key available on your SoleasPay dashboard.
* private_secretkey(string) : Your private secret key available on your SoleasPay dashboard

endpoints.name: Get available services
endpoints.text: updated list of our supported services.

endpoints.name: Collect payment (Pay-In)
endpoints.text:
To collect payment by api call.
Parameters (in Headers) :
* x-api-key : your apikey
* operation(integer) : 2
* service(integer) : The service which one your customer will pay
*otp(integer) : For orange money service, you should provide otp code in hearders or not depending of your logic.
Parameters (in JSON body) :
* wallet(string) : the wallet where we proceed the payment
* amount(float) : amount of current payment
* currency(string) : it is the currency in which you proceed the current payment
* orderId(string) : The unique order id on your apps for current payment
* description(string) : A short description of current payment
* payer(string) : The name of your cystomer
* payerEmail(string) : Customer email to receive payment receipt after confirmation
* successUrl(string) : the url to notice when payment success.
* failureUrl(string) : The failure url

endpoints.name: Disburse payment (Pay-out)
endpoints.text:
Withdraw cash from your SoleasPay account to your personnal account.
Parameters (Headers) :
* Authorization : Bearer Token.
* operation(int) : 4
* service(int) : The service which one your customer will receive fund
Parameters (JSON) :
* wallet(string) : the wallet where we proceed the payment
* amount(float) : amount to withdraw
* currency(string) : optional, it is the currency in which you proceed the current transaction

endpoints.name: Transfert funds
endpoints.text:
Transfert your balance to other SoleasPay user.
Parameters (Headers) :
* Authorization : Bearer Token.
* operation(int) : 5
* security (bool) : optional, define if transfert is secure
* code(string) : The transfert code to send to the receiver to benefit transfert
* duration(int) : The security duration in days for current transfert
* receiver(string) : The transfert receiver matricule.
Parameters (JSON) :
* amount(float) : amount to transfert
* currency(string) : optional, it is the currency in which you proceed the current transfert

endpoints.name: Verify Transaction
endpoints.text:
Check if payment is validate by customer.
Parameters (in Headers) :
* x-api-key : your apikey
Parameters (in URL) :
* orderId(string) : your unique order id for checking Payment,
* payId(string) :the SoleasPay Payment reference. You receive it in the response of Pay-In API Call

endpoints.name: Get transaction details
endpoints.text:
To get detail of one specific payment.
Parameters (Headers) :
* Authorization : Bearer Token.
Parameters (URL) :
* document : the internal transaction reference.

endpoints.name: Converter
endpoints.text:
use our free converter to get current rate of most supported currency by providing it's ISO 4217 code.
Parameters (URL) :
* amount(float) : The amount to convert.
* from(string) : origin currency from provide amount.
* to(string) : The currency where you want to convert the providing amount
